parsed.name: SDM630三相电能表
parsed.description: 用于通过总线读取三相交流电能与电力监测数据的电能表，常用于实验室供电、负载或光伏相关系统的电参数监测。
parsed.description_en: A bus-connected three-phase energy meter used to read AC electrical energy and power-monitoring data, commonly used in labs for monitoring power supplies, loads, or photovoltaic-related systems.

actions.description: 自动轮询读取电表新数据，并唤醒等待最新读数的协程。
actions.description_en: Automatically poll the meter for fresh readings and wake coroutines waiting for updated values.
